a: David Brainerd (1718–1747) yali mubuulizi omuvubuka eyaweereza abantu Abazaalirwa ba Amerika ab'omu New Jersey ne Pennsylvania ez'omu biseera by'amatwale. Yawangaala emyaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, n'amala emyaka nga ena gyokka mu buweereza, teyalaba bibiina binene, teyatandikawo kitongole kyonna, era yafiira mu nnyumba y'omuntu omulala ng'akolola omusaayi. Nga tugeraageranya mu ngeri ez'ensi zonna, obulamu bwe bwali butono — naye ekitabo ky'ennaku kye yawandiika, ekyafulumizibwa oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe Jonathan Edwards, kiweerezza abantu bangi mu nnimiro y'obuweereza okusinga ebitabo eby'obulamu bw'ababuulizi ab'ettutumu ekikumi.

Yazaalibwa mu Haddam, Connecticut, era bazadde be bombi baali bafudde nga tannaweza myaka kkumi na ena. Yali mulenzi wa birowoozo bingi era wa nnaku, eddiini nga emukwatako nnyo era nga emuteganya nnyo, ng'asiiba era ng'alongoosa empisa ze naye nga tafuna mirembe. Egyo gyajja mu mwaka gwe ogw'amakumi abiri mu ebiri gwokka: nga 12 July 1739, ng'atambula yekka akawungeezi mu "kibira ekikwafu era ekizibu," omugugu ne guggibwako mu kaseera kamu, era emmeeme ye "n'esanyuka n'essanyu eritayogerekeka, okulaba Katonda afaanana bw'atyo, Omutukuvu ow'ekitiibwa afaanana bw'atyo."

Nga bakwatiddwa omuliro gw'Okuzuukuka Okukulu, abayizi ba Yale baatandika okunenya abasomesa be baalowooza nti tebaakyusibwa mitima. Bwe yabuuzibwa mu kyama ky'alowooza ku omu eyali asabye awatali bbugumu bulabika, Brainerd yayogera ebisukkiridde — "Talina kisa kisukka ku ntebe eno" — era n'awulirwa. Omukulu w'essomero n'amusaba okwatula mu lujjudde; ng'akkiriza nti ebigambo byali bya kyama era nti ekibonerezo kyali tekya bwenkanya, n'agaana, era olw'ekyo, awamu n'okugenda kwe mu lukuŋŋaana olwaziyizibwa olw'"Abaawukana", n'agobwa mu 1742, era teyaweebwa diguli n'akatono.

q: Omulimu gwe mu Bazaalirwa gwali gutya?
a: Ng'aweereddwa olukusa mu 1742, yasooka kusenga mu Kaunaumeek, ng'abeera mu wigwam olwo n'addamu ng'abeera mu kasiisira akatono, ng'asula ku ssubi, ng'ayiga olulimi era ng'avuga amayilo mangi ng'ayita mu ddungu; oluvannyuma n'asenguka mu Forks of the Delaware era n'akola engendo enzibu era ezitaali na kibala okutuuka ku Susquehanna. Yatera okulwala, ng'atera okuwulira empewo, era kumpi bulijjo ng'ali yekka. "Saafaayo gye nnali mbeera oba engeri gye nnali mbeeramu, oba kubonaabona ki kwe nnayitamu," bwe yawandiika, "wabula okuggya emmeeme ne nzireeta eri Kristo kyokka."

Teyali mutukuvu ateredde. Ekitabo kye eky'ennaku kyamanyibwa — era eri abasomi abamu nga kyeraliikiriza — olw'okwekebera kwe okutakoowa n'ennaku eyingi; yalwanagana obulamu bwe bwonna n'ekyo kye twandiyise kaakano obuyinike, ng'eyeeyita "ekitonde ekisingira ddala obubi ku biramu" era emirundi egisukka gumu ng'ayagala kufa. Edwards, bwe yakifulumiza, yakubiriza abasomi okugoberera obwewaayo bwa Brainerd awatali kukoppa kwennyamira kwe. Naye obwesimbu obwo kitundu ku maanyi g'ekitabo ag'ekyewuunyo: wano obutukuvu bwe musajja ow'ennaku, eyeebuusabuusa, ng'anywerera ku Katonda ng'ayita mu kizikiza era ng'asituliddwa.

Brainerd yasaba ng'abasajja abalala bwe bakola emirimu — okutuusa lwe yakoowa ddala. Yayawulangako ennaku enzijjuvu olw'okusiiba n'okusaba mu kyama era "yasanyukiranga nnyo mu bifo eby'ekyama eby'okwesirika," ng'abulira mu kibira okufuka emmeeme ye ku lw'abantu be yali aweereza. Akawungeezi kamu mu Forks, nga tannasisinkana mbaga ey'okusinza bakatonda abalala, yasaba okutuusa omubiri gwe lwe gwalemererwa: "Sasobola na kutambula bulungi; ennyingo zange zaali zisumuluddwa; entuuyo zaakulukuta ku maaso gange ne ku mubiri gwange." Ku lunaku olwaddirira yaddamu okwewuŋŋula mu kibira n'awaayo nate obulamu bwe eri Katonda, ka kibe mu bulamu oba mu kufa.

Mu June 1745 yatuuka e Crossweeksung, ekitundu Abadelaware mwe baali basaasaanidde mu New Jersey, era n'abuulira, si ntiisa, wabula ekisa eky'obuwa n'okusaasira kwa Kristo. Nga 8 August 1745, eri abawuliriza nga nkaaga mu bataano, "amaanyi ga Katonda gaalabika nga gakka ku kibiina 'ng'empewo ey'amaanyi ekunta'... era ne gawangula buli kimu kye gaasanga mu maaso gaago." Abasajja abakadde abaali abatamiivu okumala emyaka mingi, abaana abato, omulaguzi n'omutemu, bonna baali bakaabirira Katonda okusaba okusaasirwa. "Saalaba lunaku lwonna olufaanana ng'olwo, mu buli ngeri."

Tekwali kuwulira kuyita buyisi. Obutamiivu bwalekebwa, amabanja gaasasulwa, entalo zaawonyezebwa, era mu myezi kkumi n'egumu abantu amakumi asatu mu munaana baali beeyatudde okukkiriza mu lujjudde, "bonna abalabika ng'abaakolerwa omulimu gw'ekisa eky'enjawulo mu mitima gyabwe." Brainerd, eyali yeegendereza era eyeebuusabuusa okuyita ekigero, yali akakasa ekintu kimu: si ye yakikola. Kyajja ng'ekirabo, mu kiseera ebyo ebyali bimulindiridde bwe byalabika nga bibi ennyo, ng'okuddamu kw'okusaba.

Akafuba akaali kamugoberedde okumala emyaka kaamunyweza; yakolola omusaayi era n'atasobola nate kwetooloola bitundu bye ng'abuulira. Mu ttoggo lya 1747 yava ku Bazaalirwa n'agenda mu maka ga Jonathan Edwards mu Northampton, gye yajjanjabirwa mu wiiki ze kkumi na mwenda ez'oluvannyuma muwala wa Edwards, Jerusha. Yafa nga essaawa nga mukaaga ku makya nga 9 October 1747, nga tannaaweza myaka amakumi asatu. "Omulimu gwange guwedde," bwe yabagamba; "okwegomba kwange kwonna kwe kugulumiza Katonda."

q: Lwaki ekitabo kye eky'ennaku kikutte nnyo ku bantu?
a: Emyaka ebiri oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe Edwards yafulumiza "An Account of the Life of the late Reverend Mr. David Brainerd", ekyazimbibwa ku kitabo ky'ennaku Brainerd kye yali amusabye okwekenneenya. Kyafuuka kimu ku bitabo eby'okwewaayo ebyasinga okuddiŋŋanwa okukubibwa mu lulimi Olungereza, era obuwulize bwakyo obw'emirembe, obw'okwemalamu era obw'obwesigwa bwakoleeza omuliro gwe yataba mulamu kulaba: John Wesley yakifunza, William Carey yakitwala e Buyindi, Henry Martyn yakisoma e Cambridge n'awaayo obulamu bwe eri obuweereza, era nga wayiseewo emyaka ebikumi bibiri Jim Elliot n'ajjuza ebitabo bye eby'ennaku mu mwoyo gwe gumu.
